mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_user (openid, unionid, nickname, avatar_file_id, gender, city, status, token_version) VALUES (#{openid}, #{unionid}, #{nickname}, #{avatarFileId}, #{gender}, #{city}, 1, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE app_user SET last_login_at=#{now}, last_login_ip=#{ip}, updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND is_deleted=0
UPDATE app_user SET nickname=#{nickname}, avatar_file_id=#{avatarFileId}, gender=#{gender}, city=#{city}, version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND is_deleted=0
UPDATE app_user SET token_version=token_version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND is_deleted=0
UPDATE app_user SET status=#{status}, token_version=IF(#{status}=0, token_version+1, token_version) WHERE id=#{id} AND is_deleted=0

SELECT r.* FROM admin_role r JOIN admin_user_role ur ON ur.role_id=r.id WHERE ur.user_id=#{adminId} AND r.status=1 AND r.is_deleted=0 ORDER BY r.sort_order, r.id

SELECT DISTINCT p.* FROM admin_permission p JOIN admin_role_permission rp ON rp.permission_id=p.id JOIN admin_user_role ur ON ur.role_id=rp.role_id JOIN admin_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=#{adminId} AND r.status=1 AND r.is_deleted=0 AND p.status=1 AND p.is_deleted=0 ORDER BY p.sort_order, p.id
SELECT * FROM admin_role WHERE code=#{code} AND status=1 AND is_deleted=0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_user (username, password_hash, nickname, avatar_file_id, email, phone, status, token_version, failed_login_count, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{nickname}, #{avatarFileId}, #{email}, #{phone}, 1, 0, 0, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
INSERT INTO admin_user_role (user_id, role_id, created_by) VALUES (#{userId}, #{roleId}, #{createdBy})
